Subject: SOC 2 Type II request for vendor onboarding (audit period clarification)

Hi Aditya,

We're starting Acme's vendor security intake for Q4 and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our assessment. Can you provide the following?

- The full SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent period (audit window: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31).
- A signed bridge letter if the report doesn't cover controls into 2025 (or confirmation that the period is current).
- A short coverage matrix mapping services/controls relevant to data classification and encryption in transit/at rest.
- Any sample logs or retention statements (redacted is fine).

Please let me know your preferred transfer mechanism (presigned S3, secure upload portal, or DocuSign/SPV for the bridge letter), and approximate ETA. Our timeline is tight — ideally we need material to the auditor by next Wednesday (2025-11-19).

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Chen
Vendor Risk Analyst — Acme Corp

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request for vendor onboarding (audit period clarification)

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can support that timeline. Quick summary of options and what we'll share:

1) What we can provide (standard package):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31.
   - Draft bridge letter (signed on company letterhead) if you need confirmation of ongoing controls coverage into 2025.
   - Coverage matrix (controls -> product areas) and a short evidence index (examples of log samples, retention statements).

2) Transfer options (pick one):
   - Presigned S3 bundle (14-day expiry). We will redact customer-specific PII before upload.
   - Secure upload to our transfer portal (requires temporary account creation; we can invite your procurement contact).
   - DocuSign for the bridge letter + secure viewer link for the report (viewer is time-limited).

3) Redaction & minimal exposure: we recommend removing any customer identifiers from log samples and providing only aggregated examples for telemetry. If Acme prefers copies with minimal redactions, we can do that under an NDA/temporary access window.

ETA: If you confirm transfer method by end of day today (11/12), I can have the report + bridge letter draft ready and the presigned link within 24 hours.

I've attached a draft bridge letter and a coverage matrix template to speed this along — feel free to use the coverage matrix for your mapping.

Best,

--

- Can you confirm what fields you redact in log samples (timestamps preserved? user IDs hashed?).
- Will the bridge letter be signed by someone in security or an exec (we prefer an exec signature for our records).

If you can push the presigned link and signed bridge letter by end of day tomorrow (11/13), that should keep us on track for the auditor.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
